propositions: CI intermittently fails authorship batching fixture setup at git merge command with exit status 1, but the stated cause (content conflict) is structurally impossible because both branches write byte-identical bytes to the single shared file.
The fixture's _git() helper captures git output but discards stderr and stdout when raising CalledProcessError, destroying diagnostic information needed to identify the actual failure cause.

Approximately 29,400 reproduction attempts (1500 git sequence replays, 40 serial module runs, 72 oversubscribed runs, 3 full test suites under xdist) produced zero failures, indicating the issue is either transient or depends on environmental factors not yet identified.
The failure is diagnosed and made catchable by surfacing git's stderr, stdout, argv, and exit code in CalledProcessError's message, without fixing the underlying unknown cause.
